Store initialization, linking, publishing, clearing, verification, and tree printing functions.

# Purpose
This C file implements the life cycle and tree management logic for `fd_store`, which is a shared-memory data store for Merkle-root keyed entries. It provides functions to create, join, leave, and delete the store in a workspace-backed memory region, and it checks alignment, memory validity, and the store magic value before use. The [`fd_store_new`](<#fd_store_new>) function sets up the store header, the hash map, the object pool, and the element array, then initializes the root state and the partition seed used by the map hash logic.

The file also defines the main store operations on `fd_store_fec_t` records: [`fd_store_insert`](<#fd_store_insert>) adds a new entry, [`fd_store_link`](<#fd_store_link>) builds parent-child and sibling links between entries, [`fd_store_publish`](<#fd_store_publish>) changes the active root and prunes old ancestors, and [`fd_store_clear`](<#fd_store_clear>) removes all entries from the store. [`fd_store_verify`](<#fd_store_verify>) checks internal consistency between the partition layout, the map, and the pool, and [`fd_store_print`](<#fd_store_print>) walks the tree and prints it in a readable form. The code uses the store map and pool APIs from the imported headers, so this file acts as the implementation layer for the store data structure and its public operations.
